• This product is manufactured with precision. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause damage.
• This product contains precision electronic components. Do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it in places that become very hot or very cold.

俺たちは世界から世界へ渡り歩く世界海賊。
略して界賊。全世界でただ一つの存在さ。
source_blocks.translation:
We are World Pirates who travel from world to world.
"Kaizoku"—World Pirates—for short. We are the only ones of our kind in the entire universe.

source_blocks.text: だったらゾックス!俺と勝負しろ!

それ通ってあちこちの世界めぐるなかで、
SDトピアってとこ乗り込んだんだ。
住人がみ〜んなこんなカッコの世界だ
俺ら二人、そん時ちょっとしくじっちゃってさ
気づいたらこの姿に変えられていた。
SDトピアの呪いだよ。
根性、全開だああああ!
はっはっは･･･ばっかだなあ。 これでお前が
死んだら、大事な家族取り戻せなくなるのに。
お前がそういう奴なのは、よーくわかった。
お前は、全力全開で、 トジテンド倒すことだけ
考えてればいい。 みんなのこと、 俺が･･･いや、
俺たちが守る!お前ら界賊の分も、
全力全開で守ってやる!
source_blocks.translation:
While traveling through various worlds,
we barged into a place called SD-topia.
It's a world where every single resident looks like this.
We messed up a bit while we were there,
and before we knew it, we'd been transformed.
It's the curse of SD-topia.
Guts... Full Throttle!
Hahaha... You're crazy. If you
die now, you'll never get your precious family back.
I get exactly what kind of guy you are.
You just need to focus entirely—full throttle—
on taking down Tojitendo. I'll protect everyone... No,
*we* will! We'll protect them with everything we've got—
full throttle—covering for you Kaizoku, too!
Heh, then I won't hold back.

source_blocks.text: フン!ツーカイに暴れさせてもらうぜ。
source_blocks.translation: Hmph! I'm gonna go wild—in true Tsukai style.

source_blocks.text: 俺が勝ったら、 代金払え!で、他の店も!
source_blocks.translation: If I win, you're paying the bill! And for the other shops, too!

source_blocks.text: いや、この世界を荒らさないって約束しろ!
source_blocks.translation: No—promise me you won't ravage this world!

source_blocks.text:
アタシたち、ゴールドツイカー一家の
モットーは?

source_blocks.text:
はっ、お前。 俺に勝てると思ってんの?
百戦錬磨の界賊の俺に?
source_blocks.translation:
Hah, you? You think you can beat me?
Me—a battle-hardened World-Pirate?
When it comes to something that looks interesting!

source_blocks.text:
勝つよ。俺は、この世界を守る為に戦うって
決めたんだ! そんでもって、世界初!
source_blocks.translation: I'll win. I've decided to fight to protect this world! And on top of that—I'll be the first in the world!

ゾックス
ゾックス

ああああああああ。 カシワモチ食いてえ!!

I'll become the hero who defeats the World Pirates!

source_blocks.translation:
Yohohoi, yohohoi, yohohoihoi...
Yohohoi, yohohoi, yohohoihoi...
Who is the one who slept with my precious little sister~♪

source_blocks.text:

いいな? 痛快にいくぜ!
source_blocks.translation:
Kashiwamochi-World. Whoever defeats him wins.
Got it? Let's make it a blast!

フリント

え?じゃあ・・・この世界も!?
source_blocks.translation:
Kashiwamochi died back then. The one I defeated was just a Mochi-World. You were the one who won the match.
Huh? Then... this world too!?

source_blocks.text: ほらよ。30万ポンギはある。 釣りはいらねえよ。
source_blocks.translation: Here. There's 300,000 Pongi. I don't need any change.

source_blocks.text:
人を誘い出せるほどの傑作マンガを、
素人が簡単に描けると思うなよ。
なんか怒られた。
source_blocks.translation:
Don't think an amateur can easily draw a masterpiece good enough to lure people out.
Somehow I got yelled at.

source_blocks.text:
仲間ができるってのは、面倒臭いな。

あたしが子供んとき、はじめて自力で
作ったのがオルゴールだったんだけどさ。
大人にはできたら見せなって言われてたけど、
まあ~歪んでるし音も変だし、ダメだ
こんなもん!って、 つい・・・でも、一生懸命
作ったから、あとでめっちゃ後悔して、
泣きながら探した。 ま、結局兄貴が
見つけてくれたんだけど。
source_blocks.translation:
Having companions is such a hassle.
You really threw that doll away yourself, didn't you?
I've done that too, you know.
When I was a kid, the first thing I ever made on my own was a music box.
Adults told me to show it to them when it was finished, but... it was warped and the sound was off, and I thought, "This is no good!" and I just... But I'd worked so hard on it, so later I regretted it terribly and searched for it while crying.
In the end my older brother found it for me, though.
